_comment: OpenAI — paid key. Copy to llm_config.json.
_security: NEVER put a real key in this file. Paste it in the app's Settings, or export OPENAI_API_KEY.
_setup: 1) Paste your key in Settings (AI provider key) and Save. 2) cp llm_config.openai.json llm_config.json 3) python3 app.py
_model_note: model = the exact id from https://platform.openai.com/docs/models. Put your KEY in the app's Settings, NOT in this file and NOT in api_key_env.
_key_note_: api_key_env is the NAME of an environment variable (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY). Do not paste the key here — paste it in Settings, or in llm_api_key.txt.
